title: Latitude And Longitude Including Important Parallels And Meridians
definition: A comprehensive geographic coordinate system utilizing a network of imaginary horizontal circles (parallels) and vertical semi-circles (meridians) to determine absolute location, time zones, and climatic zones on Earth's ellipsoidal surface.
importanceInUpsc: Fundamental prerequisite for physical geography, geomorphology, climatology, and cartography in Prelims (direct coordinate, time, and daylight questions) and GS-1 Mains (geographical phenomena distribution).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Latitude And Longitude Including Important Parallels And Meridians.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
